verdict.rationale_short: The BEARISH trigger that fired at June 23's close (SPX ~7,365, SOXX -7.88%, VIX 19.49, KOSPI 'Black Tuesday' -9.99%) has not been cleared by this morning's data — but the two designated upgrade catalysts are on deck today. NVDA Annual Meeting runs 9 AM PT (noon ET, in-session); Micron Q3 FY2026 reports after the close. BTC confirmed its Day 2 stop: Crypto.com live at $62,377 (11:07 UTC), range $61,952–$63,114, well below the $63,500 threshold — full exit gate triggered per the night-brief protocol. The setup is marginally less hostile than yesterday: ES futures +0.13%, Brent at $77.2 (3-month low on Iran supply normalization), Micron rebounding 4.1% in premarket. But the regime bar remains breached: SPX is 95 pts below its 7,460 floor, DXY at 101.38 (above 100 trigger), VIX at 19.49 (above 17 gate). BofA's 3-hike forecast (Sep/Oct/Dec 2026) is the new market rate framework, and today's flash PMI supports it — US Manufacturing 55.7 (49-month high), Composite 52.2. May PCE tomorrow (consensus 4.1% YoY headline) is the dominant risk event. STEP ASIDE upgrades from BEARISH only because both catalysts are in play today — let NVDA + Micron decide before re-risking.

bear_case: Counter-argument: the BEARISH trigger fired at the exact trough of a sector-specific panic — the KOSPI 'Black Tuesday' (-9.99%) and a single BofA research note (not a Fed statement) drove the selloff, not a broad macro deterioration. The Dow fell only 0.09% on June 23, the 10Y yield was flat at 4.48% (bonds were bid), and Brent is at 3-month lows ($77.2) — the disinflation impulse from Iran supply normalization is accelerating precisely when the rate-hike narrative is loudest. Flash PMI Manufacturing at 55.7 is a 49-month high: a strong economy historically supports corporate earnings even in tightening cycles. If NVDA confirms AI demand at the annual meeting and Micron Q3 beats with Q4 guidance above $36B, the KOSPI panic will be re-framed as a single-market valuation correction — not an AI cycle peak. Invalidation: NVDA Annual Meeting explicit AI demand confirmation + Micron Q3 Q4 guidance above $36B → STEP ASIDE converts to HOLD, selective longs re-engage (NVDA $200-208, MU $1,100+). If SPX closes above 7,460 today, the BEARISH trigger was a one-session false break.
